    ```java
    public List<String> splitPayment(String fromAccountId, String amount, List<String> payeeIds) {
        Account from = store.find(fromAccountId);
        if (payeeIds == null || payeeIds.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("NO PAYEES");
        }
        long totalCents = MoneyUtil.parseCents(amount);
        if (totalCents > from.getBalanceCents()) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("INSUFFICIENT FUNDS");
        }

        // Validate all payees exist before any money moves
        List<Account> payees = new ArrayList<>();
        for (String id : payeeIds) {
            payees.add(store.find(id));
        }

        long shareCents = totalCents / payees.size();
        long remainderCents = totalCents % payees.size();

        from.setBalanceCents(from.getBalanceCents() - totalCents);

        List<String> shares = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < payees.size(); i++) {
            long amountToPay = shareCents + (i < remainderCents ? 1 : 0);
            Account p = payees.get(i);
            p.setBalanceCents(p.getBalanceCents() + amountToPay);
            shares.add(MoneyUtil.formatCents(amountToPay));
        }
        return shares;
    }
    ```
